tasks.title: Announcement #27
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
tasks.transcript: Man: Before we get started, don't forget that the first draft of your research paper is due on Monday. This draft should include your thesis statement, main arguments, and a preliminary list of sources. It's only a draft, so it's okay if it's not perfect. The goal is to get feedback and refine your ideas. Please submit your draft electronically via the course portal by midnight on Monday.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the announcement?

options.A: To point out flaws in a research paper
options.B: To remind students about an assignment
options.C: To explain how to write a thesis statement
options.D: To invite students to a lecture on Monday

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问这则通知的主要目的是什么，属于主旨/目的理解题，需抓住男士整段话的核心意图。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 通知中提醒学生初稿需要包含的内容，但并未指出研究论文中的缺陷，属于无中生有。 选项B：正确。 男士明确提醒学生研究论文初稿周一截止，并说明了提交方式和内容要求，核心目的是提醒学生关于作业的截止日期和要求。 选项C：错误。 通知中提到初稿应包含论点陈述，但并未解释如何撰写论点陈述，属于概念混淆。 选项D：错误。 通知中讨论的是论文初稿提交，而非邀请学生参加周一的讲座，属于无中生有。

questions.stem: What does the speaker suggest about the first draft?

options.B: It should include all final sources.
options.C: It is a major part of the students' grade.
options.D: It is intended for feedback and improvement.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问说话者对初稿提出了什么看法，属于细节理解题，需抓住男士对初稿目的的描述。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 男士明确说“It's only a draft, so it's okay if it's not perfect”，说明初稿可以有错误，与选项意思相反。 选项B：错误。 男士说初稿应包含初步的参考文献列表（a preliminary list of sources），而非所有最终来源，属于程度错误。 选项C：错误。 通知中没有提到初稿占成绩的多少比重，属于无中生有。 选项D：正确。 男士明确说“The goal is to get feedback and refine your ideas”，即初稿的目的是获取反馈并完善想法。
